answers.stem_only: Use the built-in AWS Management Console access feature of AWS Managed Microsoft AD: create the directory's access URL, enable console access, and assign an IAM role to the administrators' directory group so they sign in with their directory credentials. IAM Identity Center is not the fit: an organization instance needs AWS Organizations, and an account instance cannot grant access to AWS accounts (no permission sets). AD FS plus SAML works but adds servers to run.
